text: How are the ESN readout weights obtained in the first_esn.py pipeline?
choices: By backpropagation through time over all weight matrices
By ridge regression - a single closed-form linear least-squares solve, not backpropagation through time
By stochastic gradient descent jointly over W_in, W_rec, and W_out
By unsupervised k-means clustering of the reservoir states
explanation: The readout is fit by ridge regression, a single closed-form least-squares solve; the lab explicitly notes training is 'not backpropagation through time.' SGD over all weights or BPTT would train the reservoir (which ESNs avoid), and k-means is unsupervised and irrelevant.
